svg.title: Large placements per 15 minutes, bid side against ask side
svg.desc: Mirrored column chart over the 14-hour capture, one column per 15-minute bucket: bid-side placements above the line, ask-side placements below it. Activity comes in one-sided bursts that switch sides: mostly ask side from about hour 3 to hour 7 of the capture (up to 288 per bucket), then bid side around hour 8 (up to 158), ask side around hour 9 (up to 304), bid side around hour 10 (up to 236), ask side just before hour 11 (up to 201), bid side from about hour 11 to hour 12 (up to 198), ask side around hour 13 and a last bid-side burst near hour 14.
